headline: The Cellist Jeffrey Zeigler Explores His Family’s Gullah Geechee Roots
context: In a new multidisciplinary work, the cellist Jeffrey Zeigler explores his family’s Gullah Geechee roots in South Carolina with a host of collaborators.
